test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 84,000 is deposited in a bank on simple interest at the rate of 15% for the period of 3 years. How much Simple Interest (in Rs.) will be received?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs.84000

Rate (R) = 15% ; time (T) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ (84000 × 15 × 3)/100

⇒ 840 × 45 = Rs.37800

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.37800.**
